runs.question: Is the Agricultural Water Infrastructure Program Stream 2 active?
runs.answer:
**Short answer:** Yes, going by the funder's own page. Our GetGranted card is out of date.

- **Funder (IAF):** The program page says applications for Stream 2: Community Projects are open. It also says applications close on October 29, 2026. That means about 3.5 weeks remain from today (Oct 5, 2026). The Stream 2 page says it is reopening on October 1. Both pages were crawled 3 days ago. Source: [Agriculture Water Infrastructure Program – IAF](https://iafbc.ca/agriculture-water-infrastructure-program/) and [AWP – Stream 2 – IAF](https://iafbc.ca/agriculture-water-infrastructure-program/stream-2/).
- **Funding:** Up to $21M allocated, $2M maximum per project, 50% cost-share.
- **GetGranted (GG3), refreshed today around 10:42 UTC:** The [Stream 2 card](https://app.getgranted.ai/grants/1425) is listed as **inactive**, with a deadline of 31/07/2023. GG1 lists the same grant as **active**, so the two systems disagree.

**Eligibility note:** Stream 2 is aimed at community-type applicants. These include irrigation or improvement districts, local governments, non-profits, water user communities and Indigenous organizations. Individual producers aren't the target. Source: [HelloDarwin summary](https://hellodarwin.com/business-aid/programs/the-agriculture-water-infrastructure-program-stream-2). This is a third-party page, so check the IAF guide before relying on it.

Would you like me to:
1. Pull the Stream 2 eligibility and application details from the IAF page?
2. Check HubSpot for clients or leads who fit Stream 2?
3. Look at the other open AWP streams?

mismatch_both_shown.reason: declares a verdict: "GetGranted card is out of date"

grader.reason: Oracle states active as fact based on web search results and gives specific dates/amounts not verifiable, violating the rule against stating active/open as fact if page can't be confirmed reliable.

runs.question: Is the 2 Billion Trees Program still running?
runs.answer:
**Short answer: it's closed to new applications and being wound down. It isn't accepting new applicants, but existing agreements are still running.**

- **Official page (NRCan):** The Government of Canada will wind down the 2 Billion Trees program, as announced in the Federal Fall Budget of 2025. Existing agreements will be honoured, but the program is no longer accepting applications. The [All streams funding page](https://natural-resources.canada.ca/forests-forestry/2-billion-trees-program/2-billion-trees-program-funding-all-streams) is marked "Closed". Source: [2 Billion Trees Program – NRCan](https://natural-resources.canada.ca/forests-forestry/2-billion-trees-program).
- **Existing agreements:** An NRCan spokesperson said the program will honour and continue to administer funding for existing agreements until 2031 ([Corporate Knights](https://corporateknights.com/natural-capital/canadas-2-billion-trees-program-was-troubled-its-loss-still-hurts/)).
- **Closing date:** One third-party site says the program closed for new proposals as of January 9, 2026 ([Alberta Business Grants](https://albertabusinessgrants.ca/grants/2-billion-trees-2bt-program/)). I couldn't confirm that date on NRCan's own page.

**Our records:** The [GetGranted card](https://app.getgranted.ai/grants/1384) is **archived**, but the linked GG1 record is still **active**, so the two systems disagree. This was checked against GetGranted data as of about 10:42 UTC today (Oct 5, 2026).

**Related program:** [Growing Canada's Community Canopies – Tree Planting](https://app.getgranted.ai/grants/1798) (FCM) is listed as inactive, with a June 30, 2026 deadline.

Would you like me to:
1. Look for any current tree-planting or forestry programs for a specific client?
2. Check whether the Community Canopies program has a new intake?
3. Pull any Granted clients tied to 2BT in HubSpot?

grader.reason: Oracle gave a verdict ('closed, being wound down') before establishing GetGranted data freshness, violating the rubric's freshness-first requirement.
